CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tmp_moira_members AS
WITH target_list AS (
  SELECT moira_list_key
  FROM moira_list
  WHERE lower(trim(moira_list_name)) = 'date-destiny'
), raw_members AS (
  SELECT d.moira_list_key, d.moira_list_member
  FROM moira_list_detail d
  JOIN target_list t ON t.moira_list_key = d.moira_list_key
), normalized AS (
  SELECT
    moira_list_key,
    CASE
      WHEN position('@' IN lower(trim(moira_list_member))) > 0 THEN lower(trim(moira_list_member))
      ELSE lower(trim(moira_list_member)) || '@mit.edu'
    END AS member_email
  FROM raw_members
)
SELECT * FROM normalized;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT m.member_email, s.department_name
  FROM tmp_moira_members m
  LEFT JOIN mit_student_directory s
    ON lower(trim(s.email_address)) = m.member_email
)
SELECT
  'date-destiny' AS list_name,
  'Management' AS department_name,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE department_name IS NOT NULL) AS matched_students,
  SUM(CASE WHEN department_name ILIKE '%management%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS management_students,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE department_name IS NOT NULL) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN department_name ILIKE '%management%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                  / CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE department_name IS NOT NULL) AS DOUBLE), 2)
  END AS pct_management
FROM joined;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tmp_moira_members AS
WITH target_list AS (
  SELECT moira_list_key
  FROM moira_list
  WHERE lower(trim(moira_list_name)) = 'date-destiny'
), raw_members AS (
  SELECT d.moira_list_key, d.moira_list_member_mit_id::VARCHAR AS member_mit_id, d.moira_list_member
  FROM moira_list_detail d
  JOIN target_list t ON t.moira_list_key = d.moira_list_key
)

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH members AS (
  SELECT member_mit_id, lower(trim(moira_list_member)) AS member_raw
  FROM tmp_moira_members
), member_email_guess AS (
  SELECT member_mit_id,
         CASE WHEN position('@' IN member_raw) > 0 THEN member_raw
              WHEN member_raw IS NOT NULL AND length(member_raw) > 0 THEN member_raw || '@mit.edu'
              ELSE NULL END AS member_email
  FROM members
), dir_match AS (
  SELECT m.member_mit_id, s.department_name
  FROM member_email_guess m
  LEFT JOIN mit_student_directory s
    ON lower(trim(s.email_address)) = m.member_email
), fallback_emp AS (
  SELECT m.member_mit_id, COALESCE(s.department_name, sd.department_name) AS department_name
  FROM member_email_guess m
  LEFT JOIN beaver.employee_directory e
    ON CAST(e.mit_id AS VARCHAR) = m.member_mit_id
  LEFT JOIN mit_student_directory sd
    ON lower(trim(sd.email_address)) = lower(trim(e.email_address))
  LEFT JOIN dir_match d ON d.member_mit_id = m.member_mit_id
  LEFT JOIN mit_student_directory s ON 1=0 -- anchor for COALESCE
), combined AS (
  SELECT member_mit_id, department_name FROM dir_match
  UNION ALL
  SELECT member_mit_id, department_name FROM fallback_emp
), final AS (
  SELECT member_mit_id,
         -- prefer a non-null department_name if available
         any_value(department_name) FILTER (WHERE department_name IS NOT NULL) AS department_name
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY member_mit_id
)
SELECT
  'date-destiny' AS list_name,
  'Management' AS department_name,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE department_name IS NOT NULL) AS matched_students,
  SUM(CASE WHEN department_name ILIKE '%management%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS management_students,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE department_name IS NOT NULL) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN department_name ILIKE '%management%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                  / CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE department_name IS NOT NULL) AS DOUBLE), 2)
  END AS pct_management
FROM final;
